title: Okara: The $99 CMO that handles everything #AI #MarketingTips
description:
Okara is an AI CMO that runs your marketing with a team of autonomous agents every day: SEO, GEO, an AI writer for keyword gaps, plus Reddit and Hacker News agents that find live conversations and draft replies. It replaces what used to cost over $14,000 a month for $99. Here's how it works. #Shorts #AIMarketing #AICMO
